avis.titre: Had no idea when I bought it, but wow!
avis.texte: I added this trial size while in line, to fulfill the remainder of a coupon i was using. Ive never used this brand before so I didn't have high expectations when comparing similar ingredients in products from other lines that ive usec . DrM actually worked pretty well for me, but still didn't deliver what I had hoped for. I think it's just too many steps for my skin, As it's recently become sensitive. The first day I used this product it layered very well with my moisturizer underneath my foundation. (I will state, even if you use toner, id apply it after this product.) Normally my makeup routine products pilled by the end of my 12 hour shift, but not with this one! The second and third day I noticed a minor bit of dryness around my nose and chin, but nothing unbearable. After the fourth day, my skin started looking better than it has in months. My dark spots are fading, mind you I never had any acne scars until the past year or so. My skin is smoother and I am extremely happy with this product. I am so glad that I asked the cashier if it was a popular brand before I bought it. I'm now purchasing the larger bottle and probably switching it from my previous routine due to it delivering the best results so far. avis.titre: I never imagined I'd see my skin without redness again—until
avis.texte: After countless hours of searching and researching, I learned that niacinamide could help reduce facial redness. That's when I discovered this brand on YouTube and decided to give it a try. From the very first week, I noticed the difference. By the end of the first month, most of my redness had faded. And after two months, even the stubborn red patches I thought would never go away had completely disappeared. The transformation has been nothing short of life-changing. I'm now on my second bottle and know this will forever be a staple in my routine. For context, I use it alongside a moisturizer and The Ordinary's GF 15 solution, which complement it perfectly. But the star of my routine is undeniably this product. Thank you for creating something that doesn't just promise results, but truly delivers.

If you have FUNGAL acne i wouldnt use this as there are a few ingredients that are known to cause clogged pores or cysts to appear (fungal acne only). If you have hormonal ance then youre fine (i have this). It is a nice serum, it can sometimes leave your soim feeling a bit sticky (espically if used woth other products such as a toner) so i would only use this at night, espically since it has Niacinamide which can make your skin sensitive to the sun (more likely to burn). However, niacinamide isnt a bad thing as it helps reduce redness, minimize acne/oil, and helps "brighten" (fade) dark spots (such as acne scars). Can leave tour face looking a bit oily so another reason to use at night. Also, wouldn't recommend mixing this product with anything like hyluranic acid (or however you spell it) as 10% niacinamide and the txa is already a little harsh sometimes and moxing it with other active ingredients can do more harm than good. Ive used this product before and it has faded any irritaion and acne scars (with time), it didnt happen right away but after 2 weeks of use (every night) i saw scars getting noticeably lighter. Overall, is a pretty good product that i recommend. I have eczema, dry and oily skin, am acne prone, and have hormonal acne and have never had a problem with this product.
